prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production portrait atlas for a Korean elementary classroom simulation game, sliced by CSS into 16 equal square portraits.
Create one square 2048×2048 image with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of portraits (16 cells total). Each cell is exactly one quarter of canvas width and height. Equal cells begin at x=0%,25%,50%,75% and y=0%,25%,50%,75%. The grid is mathematical, full bleed, edge-to-edge: NO outside margin, NO gutters, NO border, NO grid lines. Background is identical quiet flat light neutral gray #e1e2df in all cells. In each cell, a single distinct person is centered, shown chest-up with entire head and hair safely inside that cell, small consistent headroom, shoulders at the bottom. No portrait may overlap any neighboring cell. Faces large and legible at game-avatar size.
Style: natural friendly Korean picture-book illustration, delicately textured gouache and colored pencil on smooth paper, gentle expressive eyes and natural facial proportions, muted tasteful casual clothing. Not 3D, not photoreal, not anime, not emoji. All people are Korean. Each portrait must have a distinct face, hair, and outfit; do not repeat a face or costume. Soft diffuse daylight, simple consistent framing. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO logos, NO watermarks. Listed positions below are instructions only, never print them.
